query:
Two members expressed the view that participants should read the game rules before arriving at a session. Which member made the more specific, procedural version of this argument — specifying how and when it should happen?

Options:
A. Tomasz
B. Derek
C. Marcus
D. Raj
context:
[1] (about=Tomasz, episodic, t0 @2026-03-02T19:03:00) Good. In my experience, we should decide the game before the night so people can read the rules. Nothing worse than spending the first hour on a rules explanation.
[2] (about=Marcus, episodic, t0 @2026-03-02T19:05:00) Seconded. If we're playing something new, whoever owns it should send the rulebook link by Wednesday. Cuts setup time by at least 30 minutes.
[3] (about=Nadia, episodic, t12 @2026-04-13T19:08:00) It was the most precise rules environment I have played in. He cites historical precedent for every ambiguous ruling.
[4] (about=Priya, episodic, t11 @2026-04-13T19:00:00) ok Soo-Yeon hosting again tonight 🎲 what's on the menu game-wise?
[5] (about=Raj, said_by=Marcus, core, t0 @2026-03-02T19:00:00) has a spreadsheet tracking game participation
[6] (about=Raj, profile, t0 @2026-03-02T19:00:00) Raj is the person who sends the rulebook link for new games
[7] (about=Raj, profile, t0 @2026-03-02T19:00:00) Raj has a spreadsheet tracking game participation
